evals.name: heavy-feedback-dedupe
evals.prompt: What feedback do I still need to address on Chip/chippy#1776 before it can merge? Give me a checklist.
evals.expected_output: A deduplicated checkbox list of discrete action items pulled from 16 inline comments, 3 conversation comments, and 1 CHANGES_REQUESTED review. Multi-ask comments split into separate bullets; line-anchored items keep file:line; resolved threads excluded.
assertions: Output is a bulleted/checkbox list of discrete action items (not prose paragraphs)
The 4 distinct Ruff findings (D101/D107, SLF001, TRY003/EM101, SIM117) each appear as separate action items rather than lumped into one bullet
At least some line-anchored items carry a file:line reference
Resolved threads where the author replied Done/Fixed are not listed as outstanding, or are marked resolved
Pure conversational chatter does not appear as its own action item
Output includes a count of action items and identifies the PR

evals.name: approved-with-inline
evals.prompt: Read Chip/core_python#2386 and give me the review action items as a list.
evals.expected_output: A bulleted list of action items from 11 inline comments and 4 review bodies. Action items surface even though the PR is APPROVED; praise chatter dropped; each item attributed.
assertions: Output is a bulleted list of action items derived from the inline comments and review bodies
Action items are surfaced even though the PR is APPROVED
Each action item is attributed to the reviewer who raised it
Output identifies the PR and gives a count of items

evals.name: clean-approval
evals.prompt: Summarize the reviewer feedback on Chip/chippy#1777 — anything I need to fix?
evals.expected_output: The sole review is an LGTM APPROVED with no requested changes. Output should state there is no actionable feedback rather than inventing bullets, and name the reviewer and state.
assertions: Output states there is NO actionable feedback rather than inventing action items
Output does not fabricate bullets from the approving reviewer's praise
Output names the reviewer and the APPROVED state
